title: Friendship with Trumbauer, now in aeronautics
summary: They meet at Kansas City theater dates, and he sends Christmas cards until his death.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: He says, "I'm in aeronautics." He says, "I'm off everyday like 2:30." So we used to go like a couple times a year at least to play downtown at a white theater and whenever we did that theater, he would always come visit me and we'd go out and have dinner together and he spent the whole afternoon after he got off of work with me. He really liked me. Then up until he died, every Christmas, I got a Christmas card from him up -- you know, for the rest of his life until he died.
